name: Riblah
brief: Babylonian headquarters during the conquest of Judah
short: Riblah was a city in Hamath where the Babylonians set up their headquarters during their campaigns against Judah (<ref="2Ki. 23:33; 25:6, 20-21; Jer. 39:5-6; 52:9-10, 26-27">2Ki. 23:33; 25:6, 20-21; Jer. 39:5-6; 52:9-10, 26-27</ref>).
